name: 4-point test
definition: A geometric test used to determine if a triangle belongs to the convex contour of volumetric data. It assumes triangles on the convex contour face inside the convex hull of the negative space.
summary: The 4-point test is a local geometric predicate that filters candidate triangulations for convex contouring by enforcing the convex hull property on edge intersections, distinguishing itself from hierarchical methods.
